name: Mercure Pangkalan Bun
short_description: The first Accor hotel in Central Kalimantan, a 150-room riverside property in Pangkalan Bun near Tanjung Puting National Park.
ai_summary: Mercure Pangkalan Bun is the first Accor hotel in Central Kalimantan, positioned in the riverside town of Pangkalan Bun a short drive from the Arut River and around 15 minutes from Iskandar Airport. The 150-room hotel spans seven room and suite categories up to a President Suite, with an All Day Dining restaurant, lobby lounge and pool bar, wellness center, and meeting space for up to 650 guests. Guests praise its clean, comfortable rooms, strong breakfast, and helpful staff, and many use it as a base before or after a klotok riverboat trip into nearby Tanjung Puting National Park to see wild and rehabilitated orangutans; some reviews note slow bar and restaurant service.

About 15 minutes from Iskandar Airport, making it a convenient overnight base

All Day Dining restaurant, lobby lounge, pool bar, and a wellness center on site

cons: Some guests report long waits for food and drinks at the bar and restaurant

research_highlights: Its role as the pre/post-trip base for Tanjung Puting National Park orangutan tours is a recurring theme in reviews
Cleanliness, room comfort, and staff friendliness are the most consistently praised aspects
The rooftop-area pool and overall property presentation draw favorable comment as the town's most polished hotel
research_watchouts: Multiple reviews flag slow service at the bar and restaurant during busier periods
Some guests find bar and breakfast pricing higher than expected for the location

faqs.question: Is Mercure Pangkalan Bun a good base for visiting Tanjung Puting National Park?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it is commonly used as an overnight base before or after a klotok riverboat trip into Tanjung Puting National Park to see wild and rehabilitated orangutans, since Pangkalan Bun is the main overland and air gateway to the park via the nearby port of Kumai. The hotel is about 15 minutes from Iskandar Airport.

faqs.question: What room categories does Mercure Pangkalan Bun offer?
faqs.answer: The 150-room hotel offers seven categories, from 27-square-meter Premium Superior rooms and 39-square-meter Deluxe rooms up to a 59-square-meter Junior Suite, a 62-square-meter Executive Suite, and a 95-square-meter President Suite, all with IP TV, high-speed WiFi, and a mini fridge.
